issues.title: Keep the header in view while the page scrolls
issues.body:
On a long page the reader loses the title. Keep the header visible at the top as the page scrolls, at both widths.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

## Technical decisions
None: CSS inside the existing page.

prs.title: Keep the header in view
prs.body:
Makes the header sticky. Adds Tailwind for the utility classes; run `npm run build` after editing `src/site.css`.

Closes #13
